{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Replace -999.0 with NaN in biomarker_baseline
df['biomarker_baseline'] = df['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Also check biomarker_final for sentinel values
print("Sentinel values in biomarker_final:")
sentinel_final = df['biomarker_final'].isin([-999.0, -999])
print(df[sentinel_final]['biomarker_final'].value_counts())"}
